title: psoralea decidua
intro: Psoralea decidua, commonly known as "Tall Indian Breadroot", is a perennial plant native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to stimulate thyroid function, improve skin health, and enhance bone growth. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea decidua include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and isoflavones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
